diagnostic.scope: Exploratory local-luminance diagnostic of the original four held-out material contexts and three fixed noise draws. All225 disjoint16px blocks per context retained. Orthonormal DCT-II, frequencies k/(2N), radial band [1/8,1/3). GT-only eligibility/bins fixed before output analysis. Conditional scalar projection can contain chance noise/GT correlation; no noise debiasing or fine-carrier recovery claim. Local coarse structure and block boundaries can leak into the band. No inference/training/default/source-data/queue changes.
